[quote:762e1e395b]just tilt the hologram and the mouth opens[/quote:762e1e395b]

Just a suggestion, since I don't know how ventriloquism works, but the idea is to work the mouth pretty much in synch with the words, right? In this case, couldn't you make a hologram with a bunch of different references, say, 40 degrees, 50 degrees and 60, with each one at a different mouth position. Then by manipulating switches, you could illuminate with the different lights set at these positions and show the mouth moving? Of course, you'd need to hide the lights, so your dummy would have to appear on a small stage or something to explain why there's a covering over the head.
